sources.note: D-subminiature article (opened): normal-density contacts 2.76 mm apart in a row (326/3000 in), rows 2.84 mm apart and offset by half a pitch; 13 + 12 contacts for 25 pins. The shell and flange sizes (D shell 38.96 x 8.36 mm, flange 53.04 mm) are typical shell-size-B values NOT verified here (the article does not give them); pin diameter 1 mm and length 5 mm, hood 56 x 16 mm, boot and overall 62 mm are ESTIMATES. The catalog dsub25 is the TASCAM-pinout analog / AES59 port; the model is the male cable plug.
